# Laney Lee

> > Middle school science teaching resources aligned with NGSS standards, featuring CER (Claim-Evidence-Reasoning) prompts, stations activities, and differentiated assessments.

Laney Lee is a middle school science teacher who creates comprehensive, standards-aligned teaching materials for life science, earth science, and physical science topics. Resources include practice worksheets, unit tests, study guides, and engaging activities compatible with Google Classroom, Google Slides, and other digital platforms.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- CER (Claim-Evidence-Reasoning)
- Middle School Science
- Differentiated Instruction
- Scientific Method
- Stations Activities
- Google Classroom Integration
- Life Science
- Earth Science
- Assessment Tools
- Teacher Resources
- Practice Worksheets
- Unit Planning
- Digital Learning

## About & Planning Resources

- [About - Laney Lee](https://laney-lee.com/about): About Laney Lee, middle school science teacher and resource creator
- [Life Science Planning Resources](https://laney-lee.com/life-science-planning-resources): Life science unit planning resources for middle school teachers

## Scientific Method & Investigation

- [Scientific Method Stations](https://laney-lee.com/product/scientific-method-stations): Stations activity for investigating variables, controls, and hypotheses
- [Identifying Variables and Controls Practice Worksheet with Minecraft](https://laney-lee.com/product/identifying-variables-and-controls-practice-worksheet-pdf): Minecraft-themed worksheet for practicing scientific method variables
- [CER Posters - Science Classroom Decor](https://laney-lee.com/product/cer-posters): Claim-Evidence-Reasoning anchor chart posters for science classrooms

## Life Science Resources

- [Cells Unit Test](https://laney-lee.com/product/cells-unit-test-pdf-digital): Unit test covering cell organelles, cell theory, and organization
- [Cells Vocabulary Self Checking Review](https://laney-lee.com/product/cells-vocabulary-self-checking-review-wordsearch-pdf-google-slides): Self-checking wordsearch for cell biology vocabulary review
- [DNA Study Guide](https://laney-lee.com/product/dna-study-guide-pdf-digital): Study guide covering DNA transcription, translation, and replication
- [DNA Base Pairing Worksheet](https://laney-lee.com/product/dna-base-pairing-worksheet-pdf): DNA base pairing practice worksheet for heredity unit

## Earth Science Resources

- [MS-ESS3-2 Natural Hazards Stations - Data Analysis](https://laney-lee.com/product/ms-ess3-2-natural-hazards-stations-data-analysis-pdf-digital): NGSS MS-ESS3-2 aligned stations for analyzing natural hazards data
- [Geology Study Guide](https://laney-lee.com/product/geology-study-guide-pdf-digital): NGSS-aligned geology study guide covering plate tectonics and rock cycle
- [Legislation Affecting the Earth Stations](https://laney-lee.com/product/legislation-affecting-the-earth-stations): Stations covering environmental legislation like Clean Air Act and ESA
- [Human Impact Unit Test](https://laney-lee.com/product/human-impact-unit-test-pdf-digital): Rigorous unit test on human impact and environmental sustainability

## Physical Science Resources

- [Energy and Work CER Prompts](https://laney-lee.com/product/energy-work-cer-prompts-pdf-digital): CER prompts for energy and work concepts aligned with NGSS standards
- [Kinetic and Potential Energy - Practice Worksheets](https://laney-lee.com/product/kinetic-and-potential-energy-worksheets): Practice worksheets for kinetic and potential energy equations
- [Heat Transfer and States of Matter CER Prompts](https://laney-lee.com/product/heat-transfer-and-states-of-matter-cer-prompts): NGSS-aligned CER prompts for heat transfer and matter concepts
- [Physical and Chemical Changes CER Prompts](https://laney-lee.com/product/physical-and-chemical-changes-cer-prompts): CER prompts for physical and chemical changes in chemistry
